description: Primary SKU or product identifier used as the unique key for inventory records.
Human-readable product name or title as shown in catalogs and order systems.
Extended product description or supplemental detail text beyond the main item name.
Secondary description line, alternate title, or additional item labeling.
Total quantity currently available in inventory (on hand).
Quantity already allocated to open pick lists or fulfillment orders.
Quantity on incoming purchase orders not yet received into stock.
Minimum desired on-hand quantity; likely used as a reorder threshold.
Maximum desired on-hand quantity cap for stocking levels.
Internal standard cost per unit used for valuation or margin calculations.
Cost from purchase orders, likely the most recent or default PO unit cost.
Vendor-side on-order metric; may represent value or quantity tied to open POs.
Count of open purchase orders referencing this product.
Expected date or identifier for the next incoming purchase order.
Quantity expected on the next incoming purchase order.
Boolean flag indicating the item is non-stock (not tracked as regular inventory).
Boolean flag to exclude this product from external data exports.
Boolean flag marking the product inactive and likely hidden from normal use.
Boolean flag marking the product as discontinued/no longer sold.
Numeric identifier for the primary vendor or supplier.
Primary vendor or supplier name.
Month-to-date sales total for the product (units or dollars).
Year-to-date sales total for the product.
Sales total for the prior calendar or fiscal year.
Lifetime or all-time cumulative sales total.
Minimum order quantity required by the vendor.
Minimum purchase order dollar amount required by the vendor.
UPC or barcode identifier for scanning and retail integration.
List price, likely the published wholesale list price.
Mid-tier or member price, possibly MAP or discounted wholesale price.
Original catalog wholesale price before current pricing changes.
Reference to a printed or digital catalog page number.
Warehouse or storage location code where stock is held.
On-hand quantity at the specified warehouse location.
Pick bin or slot location used during order fulfillment.
Country of origin code for the product.
Material composition or material type description.
Carton-to-carton or cost-to-cost flag; exact business meaning needs verification.
Unit of measure for ordering and inventory (e.g., IN, YD, LB).
Product length dimension.
Product width dimension.
Product height dimension.
Product weight.
Unit of measure for product weight (e.g., LB).
Product diameter dimension, used for round items.
General size descriptor when length/width/height are not sufficient.
Shipping or retail package length.
Shipping or retail package width.
Shipping or retail package height.
Shipping or retail package weight.
Unit of measure for package weight.
Inner pack quantity (units per inner pack).
Inner pack length dimension.
Inner pack width dimension.
Inner pack height dimension.
Inner pack weight.
Unit of measure for inner pack weight.
Case quantity (units per master case/carton).
Case width dimension.
Case length dimension.
Case height dimension.
Case weight.
Primary product category or collection tag (hierarchical taxonomy level 1).
Secondary category tag (taxonomy level 2).
Tertiary category tag (taxonomy level 3).
Category tag level 4 for merchandising or navigation.
Category tag level 5 for merchandising or navigation.
Category tag level 6 for merchandising or navigation.
Category tag level 7 for merchandising or navigation.
Category tag level 8 for merchandising or navigation.
Category tag level 9 for merchandising or navigation.
Category tag level 10 for merchandising or navigation.
Boolean flag controlling visibility on the wholesale web storefront.
Boolean flag controlling visibility on the retail web storefront.
Manufacturer or vendor item/manufacturer code (MFG/SKU cross-reference).
Primary alternate product code or cross-reference SKU.
Second alternate product code.
Third alternate product code.
Default quantity used when adding the item to orders or carts.
Default weight value used when actual weight is not specified.
Unit of measure for the default weight.
Line-level commission flag or amount for sales rep compensation.
Boolean flag enabling a discount rule when the item is oversold.
Discount percentage applied when oversold discount is enabled.
